# Liberture

> Liberture is a Nostr-based app for building habits, planning tasks and tracking progress on the web or through an AI assistant. Its public library connects protocols and habits to sources across six pillars of health and personal development.

## The app

- [Sign in and get started](https://liberture.com/get-started): Use a Nostr browser extension (NIP-07) or remote signer (NIP-46). Existing accounts can also sign in with their Liberture API key. Nostr provides identity. Personal tracker data is stored in the Liberture account.
- [Habit tracker](https://liberture.com/tracker): Create and schedule habits, record check-ins and measured values, follow streaks, and review progress in day, week, matrix and statistics views. Organize todos into projects and schedule tasks and events on the calendar.
- [Marketplace](https://liberture.com/tracker?view=market): Search and filter protocols and individual habits by pillar, cost, effort or author. Review the source and adopt a routine into your tracker.
- [Settings](https://liberture.com/tracker): Manage profile, focus habits, language, time zone, reminders and notification permissions. Devices with push enabled can receive reminders while Liberture is closed. Export or restore a JSON backup, or merge check-in history from another tracker.
- [How it works](https://liberture.com/how-it-works): Overview of the tracker, protocols and assistant workflows. The optional coach can recommend routines and follow up according to the user's check-in preferences.

## Assistants and developer interfaces

- [Assistant setup](https://liberture.com/docs), [Claude](https://liberture.com/docs/claude), [ChatGPT](https://liberture.com/docs/chatgpt): Connect the [MCP server](https://liberture.com/mcp) and approve access to your account. Each connected assistant can be disconnected individually.
- [API reference](https://liberture.com/docs/api) and [live OpenAPI specification](https://liberture.com/api/v1/openapi.json): The specification lists current operations, parameters and authentication requirements. Operations cover daily summaries, habit logging and history, todos, projects, calendar events, statistics, catalog search and adoption, coach suggestions, profile and reminder status, data export and history import.
- [Permissions](https://liberture.com/docs/permissions): Users control what assistants may read and change. Permission and activity-history tools are included in the API reference.
- [Connector metadata](https://liberture.com/api/v1/integrations) and [connector updates](https://liberture.com/docs/updates): Find the current connector URL, tool count and version, and how to refresh a connection.

## Public resources

- [Pillars](https://liberture.com/pillars): Cognition, Recovery, Fueling, Mental, Physicality and Finance.
- [Protocol library](https://liberture.com/protocols): Explore, share or download structured routines and add their habits to the tracker.
- [Directory](https://liberture.com/directory): Browse [people](https://liberture.com/people), [books](https://liberture.com/books) and [organizations](https://liberture.com/organizations).
- [Articles](https://liberture.com/articles) and [guides](https://liberture.com/guides): Editorial content and practical instructions.
- [Games](https://liberture.com/games): Interactive sleep and hydration tools.
- [About](https://liberture.com/about), [support](https://liberture.com/support), [privacy](https://liberture.com/privacy) and [sitemap](https://liberture.com/sitemap.xml).

## Public content APIs

- [People](https://liberture.com/api/people), [books](https://liberture.com/api/books), [organizations](https://liberture.com/api/organizations), [protocols](https://liberture.com/api/protocols), [articles](https://liberture.com/api/articles) and [marketplace](https://liberture.com/api/marketplace).
